commands.description: Run a JSON job (--config) or ordered --step operations
commands.name: chopper run
commands.notes:
Each --step appends an operation. Step options belong to the preceding --step. Job-wide settings may appear anywhere.
Use --flag=value for values beginning with '-'. Names and indices have separate flags.
Example: chopper run --input input.csv --output results --step shuffle --strategy auto --step partition --by country --yes
